messages:
deploy-bot: [wave3] rolling stage3 -> prod-eu: feature flag 'kv-cache-optim'=ON, model v4-quant (shard set eu-west-1). watch window 5m.

alice: seeing elevated 502/5xx on EU canaries ~1m after rollout. spike at backend pool 3.

b en: paging oncall. pd alert triggered: EU-canvas 502-rate > 3% for 2m.

ben: I'm oncall, taking this. initial triage: healthcheck failures on /healthz returning 502, downstream L7 shows kvcache errors.

carla: logs show a lot of messages like: `KVCacheMissError: slot mismatch for seq 0x4f` across model-serving pods. started right after `kv-cache-optim` toggle.

alice: impact: ~2.8% of prod-eu requests 5xx, some short tail latency 300-800ms. few customer error reports via support. Not widespread yet.

b en: can we toggle flag back quickly? what's safety cutoff?

carla: flag is controlled in LaunchDarkly under `prod-eu/kv-cache-optim`. revert time <30s.

ben: ok plan: 1) flip flag OFF for prod-eu, 2) scale down new variant pool, 3) if errors persist, failover to v4-nonquant.

ben: executing flag toggle now -> `ldclient.toggle('prod-eu/kv-cache-optim', false)`

deploy-bot: Feature flag update: 'kv-cache-optim' set to OFF for environment prod-eu by ben.

carla: pushing a config to routing to prefer stable pool; doing a controlled drain of affected pods.

alice: quick check: 5xx rate dropping in last 30s to 0.9% (from 2.8%).

ben: good. keep monitoring 5m window. open a quick incident note on ops board.

ops-rotation: PD incident created: INC-2026-8343. severity: P2. linked to this slack thread.

carla: also noticed increased memory churn on pods with quantized kernel; probably a regressed codepath in KV handling after quantization. filing ticket: INF-1957.

dave: are customers impacted? any major tenants in eu-west-1?

alice: early reports from one customer integration tests failing (dev envs). no major latency SLO breaches yet. Support queue got 6 CS tickets in 10m.

ben: verdict: rollback to previous rollout state not required yet — flag flip reduced errors. but we'll hold the remainder of wave3. set rollout pause.

ben: setting rollout state -> PAUSED. deploy-bot: wave3 paused.

carla: collecting core dumps + sample requests; will attach to INF-1957. If we can't replicate, prepare for blue/green rollback to v4-nonquant.

alice: monitoring shows error rate stable ~0.7% over last 3m. no new pager escalations.

ben: handoff: I'm primary oncall for next 30m, then carla will take over for postmortem and follow-ups. Please add any customer reports to INC-2026-8343.

ops-rotation: Handoff logged. next oncall: carla @ 6398765760.

carla: I'll run a focused stress test in staging to reproduce kvcache slot mismatch under quantized path and verify fix. ETA 2 hours for initial reproducer.

dave: can we communicate to support: brief note that EU rollout paused due to internal stability check, limited customer impact, mitigation in place?

ben: yes, writing a short blurb for support: "We paused a portion of an EU rollout after detecting elevated 5xx tied to a cache optimization toggle. We've reverted the toggle for affected region and error rates have fallen. We're investigating root cause; no customer data exposure detected. Support will escalate any urgent reports to oncall."

alice: added to support message thread and updated INC-2026-8343.

carla: next steps: attach logs, create reproducer, coordinate fix with runtime team, decide on canary resume strategy (likely smaller pct + enhanced metrics).

ben: closing immediate pager: systems stable. keep this thread for follow-ups and postmortem notes.

sre-bot: Auto-check: 1) alert suppression created for linked PD incident, 2) recording CPU/mem snapshots for timeframe 6398765432-6398765550.

ben: thanks. tagging @eng-runtime for urgency.

carla: quick note for postmortem: probable regression in kv-index calc under quantized kernel when sequence length=1; include perf traces.

dave: will schedule a 1hr postmortem sync later today 16:30 UTC.

ben: handoff complete. leaving the thread to carla for long-running investigation. :white_check_mark:
